result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: the circular action button in the top-right header is missing its icon while still displaying a notification badge dot.

issues.description: The circular button in the top-right corner of the header (opposite the delivery address) renders as an empty gray circle with a red notification dot, missing its central icon (such as a bell or cart icon).
issues.suggestion: Ensure the icon asset or vector graphic inside the top-right header button loads properly and has visible contrast against the light gray background.
